_comment: One shipment on its way to Amazon, so 'in transit' is not zero in this
run. That matters: coverage is on hand + on order + in transit, and
with every in-transit figure at zero the report could add two of the
three and still look right. 10-0042 has 54 on hand, 150 on order and
60 in transit — three different numbers, no two of which sum to the
same total as all three. It is deliberately not one of the parts in
the FBA send plan, so the box arithmetic is unaffected.
